race.title: Oddschecker Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (Registered As The Tom Olliver Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: HAVAILA is a chaser very much on the upgrade and could still be ahead of his mark given the manner of his bet365 Gold Cup win at Sandown. King of Answers and Ask Brewster are both expected to bounce back so they head the dangers. HAVAILA (IRE) KING OF ANSWERS (IRE) ASK BREWSTER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Havaila (3/1), King Of Answers (4/1), Resplendent Grey (5/1), Ask Brewster (11/2), Double Powerful (8/1), Holokea (10/1), Monbeg Genius (12/1), U Cant Be Serious (12/1), Guard The Moon (16/1)
